answer:
The safe‑mode flag disables any inline JavaScript that is embedded directly in the eval configuration. In practice it turns off:

> "Reject inline JavaScript assertions and shared transforms."  
>  [promptfoo/site/docs/usage/command-line.md]  

and more specifically:

> "Reject string‑based JavaScript assertions and inline expressions handled by the shared transform helper."  
>  [promptfoo/site/docs/configuration/expected-outputs/javascript.md]
